mn113:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn113:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn113:2.1: Sappurisadhammañ ca vo, bhikkhave, desissami asappurisadhammañ ca.
mn113:2.3: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn113:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso uccā kulā pabbajito hoti.
mn113:3.4: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi uccā kulā pabbajito; ime pan' aññe bhikkhū na uccā kulā pabbajitā ti.
mn113:3.5: So tāya uccākulīnatāya attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:3.7: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:3.8: Na kho uccākulīnatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti;
mn113:3.9: no ce pi uccā kulā pabbajito hoti,
mn113:3.10: so ca hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo so tattha pāsaṃso ti.
mn113:3.11: So paṭipadaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya uccākulīnatāya n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:4-6.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso mahākulā pabbajito hoti -- pe -- heṭṭhimanayena vitthāretabbaṃ --;
mn113:4-6.5: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito; ime pan' aññe bhikkhū na uḷārabhogakulā pabbajitā ti.
mn113:4-6.6: So tāya uḷārabhogatāya attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:4-6.8: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave iti, paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:4-6.9: Na kho uḷārabhogatāya lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti;
mn113:4-6.10: no ce pi uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito hoti,
mn113:4-6.11: so ca hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo so tattha pāsaṃsoti.
mn113:4-6.12: So paṭipadaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya uḷārabhogatāya n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī.
mn113:7.3: Ahaṃ kho ' mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū appaññātā appesakkhā ti.
mn113:7.4: So tena ñātattena attān" ukkaṃseti param vamheti.
mn113:7.7: Na kho ñātattena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti;
mn113:7.8: no ce pi ñāto hoti yasassī,
mn113:7.9: so ca hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo so tattha pāsaṃso ti.
mn113:7.10: So paṭipadaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tena ñātattena n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
mn113:8.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū na lābhino cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānan ti.
mn113:8.4: So tena lābhena attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.

mn113:8.7: Na kho lābhena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti,
mn113:8.9: so ca hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo so tattha pāsaṃso ti.
mn113:8.10: So paṭipadaṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tena lābhena n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

mn113:9.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi bahussuto, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū na bahussutā ti.
mn113:9.4: So tena bāhusaccena attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.

mn113:16-20.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sosāniko hoti -pe --

mn113:16-20.8: So tena ekāsanikattena attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.

mn113:21.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicc' akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn113:21.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū na paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā lābhino ti.
mn113:21.4: So tāya paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:21.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti patisañcikkhati :
mn113:21.7: Paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā;
mn113:21.8: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā ti.
mn113:21.9: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya paṭhamajjhānasamāpattiyā n' eva attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:22-24.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ -- tatiyajjhānaṃ --
mn113:22-24.5: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā na lābhino ti.
mn113:22-24.6: So tāya catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:22-24.8: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:22-24.9: Catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā:
mn113:22-24.10: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā ti.
mn113:22-24.11: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya catutthajjhānasamāpattiyā n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:25.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā: Ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn113:25.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino ti.
mn113:25.4: So tāya ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:25.7: Ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā;
mn113:25.8: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā ti.
mn113:25.9: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā n' ev' attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:26.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamā: Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn113:26.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino ti.
mn113:26.4: So tāya viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:26.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:26.7: Viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā;
mn113:26.8: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti annathā ti.
mn113:26.9: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā n' eva attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:27.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamā: Na 'tthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn113:27.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā labhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino ti.
mn113:27.4: So tāya ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā attān' ukkaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:27.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:27.7: Ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā;
mn113:27.8: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā ti.
mn113:27.9: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā n' eva attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:28.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn113:28.3: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino ti.
mn113:28.4: so tāya nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā attān' ukaṃseti paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:28.6: Sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn113:28.7: Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā pi kho atammayatā vuttā Bhagavatā;
mn113:28.8: yena yena hi maññanti tato taṃ hoti aññathā ti.
mn113:28.9: So atammayataṃ yeva antaraṃ karitvā tāya nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā n' eva attān' ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.
mn113:29.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave; sappuriso sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamā saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhayāpenti.
mn113:29.2: Ayam pi, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na kiñci maññati, na kuhiñci maññati, na kenaci maññatīti.
mn113:29.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. 114. 2
